designer-initial.summary: Retained a visibility-priority whole-cabin HVAC supervisor with 15 behavioral usages, 33 typed semantic interactions, 30 closed owner-local cases, 10 distinct scenario families, and independent recovery and fresh-authorization state owners.
questions_for_model: Can the trusted SysML-AADL/GUMBO subset express two independent finite pre-state owners and expose PART-14's same-evaluation recovery event to PART-09 without an implicit cycle or scheduling delay?

Can a depth-two realization preserve exactly 33 end-to-end semantic interactions as 44 raw connections while carrying atomic finite actuation-plan and status records through supported port and data forms?

Can the deterministic analyzer exhaust or semantics-preservingly factor all local owner partitions and four-evaluation recovery traces within the harness watchdog while retaining witnesses for all 30 cases and 10 scenario families?
Can contracts distinguish one-evaluation New request and Fresh acknowledgment events from held values without assuming executable semantics outside this run profile?

diversity.closest_baseline: none; no diversity card was supplied
diversity.why_not_extension_or_rename: No frozen baseline applies to this run; the scope was independently selected from the reusable seed and no diversity comparison is claimed.

model-review.summary: Close one readiness interface and two status-cause relation gaps; retain the 15/33/30/10 allocation and domain behavior.

findings.evidence: PART-10 is credited with Ventilate applicability and CASE-25 permits Ventilate only when equipment permits it, but INT-20 carries only thermal-path readiness. PART-09 has no PART-08 input and PART-10 receives blower readiness through no other interaction, so the planned owner-local Ventilate relation lacks a required assigned input.
findings.requested_change: Change only INT-20's payload to carry blower readiness together with thermal-path readiness from PART-08 to PART-10. Keep PART-01..PART-15, INT-01..INT-33, all metrics, cases, scenarios, priorities, and fault behavior unchanged.

findings.evidence: PART-06 distinguishes budget denial from interface invalidity and CASE-27 requires an all-off candidate with its corresponding winning cause, but CTRL-02 has no ElectricalDenied value and INT-29 carries only the all-off plan. That plan is extensionally identical to other all-off holds, so PART-15 cannot recover or publish the denial distinction without falsely using ElectricalUnavailable.
findings.requested_change: Add ElectricalDenied to CTRL-02 cause; extend the existing INT-29 payload with PART-13's candidate-plan cause; and require PART-15 to publish the denied all-off result as mode=Degraded/cause=ElectricalDenied, the COMP-03 form for None with a noncritical cause. INT-29 remains one interaction, and no PART, metric, case count, scenario count, priority, recovery rule, or claim-boundary exclusion changes.

findings.evidence: PART-14 can receive concurrent InvalidVisibility, EquipmentFault, and ElectricalUnavailable facts but must emit one critical cause, while SCN-07 explicitly includes combined noncritical invalidity although CTRL-02 can carry only one of InvalidThermal, InvalidHumidity, and InvalidAirQuality. No selected policy defines either precedence, so the planned finite relations are not functional for required valuations and zero-overlap/result-correct analysis is impossible.
findings.requested_change: Define one deterministic critical-cause precedence in PART-14 and one deterministic noncritical-degradation precedence in PART-09's selected-intent/status summary, carry the latter on existing INT-30, and enumerate simultaneous cause combinations in ANALYSIS-01/03 and SCN-07/08 variants. Preserve every control, priority, state-transition, and suppression outcome; only the previously unspecified single status cause is completed.

findings.evidence: Extensional audit of all 15 planned owners finds genuine classification, combination, state-dependent choice, or composition. Simple domains have nonidentity fibers (PART-03: invalid glazing collapses three values; PART-04: invalid values collapse and Dry/Acceptable share None; PART-05: invalid values collapse; PART-07: eligibility fibers are 1/3), while PART-01/02/06/08..15 combine multiple facts or pre-state. PART-15 is creditable only for mode/cause classification and consistency/suppression; copied plan fields, record construction, and fan-out remain uncredited.

SysML-AADL library commit 9016cbcceefa92f0068e1811923704dd261d15f1, trusted Isolette patterns, and current Sireum v4.20260630.386eac9f accepted models support one System root, one behavior-free Process, sibling Threads, typed DataPorts/PortConnections, attribute-based records, local GUMBO state with In(...), actual-next state outputs, compute cases, and logical same-evaluation sibling composition. Eleven two-hop boundary interactions plus 22 direct internal interactions yield exactly 44 raw connections.
findings.requested_change: Realize the selected depth-two mapping, declare all GUMBO-inspected record fields as attributes, and treat New/Fresh as finite current-snapshot DataPort values under ASM-01; claim no executable scheduling or event semantics.

findings.evidence: Factorized bounded analysis is feasible: primitive owner products include 96 PART-01 values, 12 PART-06 values, and 162 PART-08 values, and canonical owner relations keep four-step state traces small. Current retained analyzers under the same 180-second watchdog have exhausted 1,492,992 valuations and factorized a 47,185,920-valuation product in about 1.5 seconds. The run has no executable profile.

designer-resolution.summary: Approved after three local relation and status-cause corrections; generation is authorized on the retained 15/33/30/10 baseline.
